checks.descripcion: sshd -t acepta la configuración del kit
checks.cmd: test -n "$BC_SSH_LAB" || { echo "solo dentro del laboratorio"; exit 1; }; d=$(mktemp -d); sudo ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null; sudo groupadd -f ssh-users; sudo groupadd -f sftp-only; sudo usermod -aG ssh-users alumno; sed "s|/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d|{proyecto}/server/sshd_config.d|" /etc/ssh/sshd_config > $d/main; sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -t -f $d/main

checks.descripcion: Con el kit en un sshd real, alumno (de ssh-users) entra con llave

checks.descripcion: bin/sshd-deploy aplica el kit: antes la contraseña entraba, después no
checks.cmd: test -n "$BC_SSH_LAB" || { echo "solo dentro del laboratorio"; exit 1; }; d=$(mktemp -d); sudo ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null; sudo groupadd -f ssh-users; sudo groupadd -f sftp-only; sudo usermod -aG ssh-users alumno; sudo pkill -f "^/usr/sbin/sshd -p 2207"; sudo rm -rf /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d.anterior; sudo cp -r {raiz}/lab/sshd_config.d /etc/ssh/; ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N "" -f $d/k; sudo mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ak; sudo cp $d/k.pub /etc/ssh/ak/alumno; sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -p 2207 -o ListenAddress=127.0.0.1 -o AuthorizedKeysFile=/etc/ssh/ak/%u; sleep 0.5; echo "Host t" > $d/cfg; for l in "HostName 127.0.0.1" "Port 2207" "User alumno" "IdentityFile $d/k" "IdentitiesOnly yes" "BatchMode yes" "StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new" "UserKnownHostsFile $d/kh" "LogLevel ERROR" "ControlMaster auto" "ControlPath $d/cm" "ControlPersist 1m"; do echo "  $l" >> $d/cfg; done; export SSH_CMD="ssh -F $d/cfg" DEPLOY_TIMEOUT=3; pw() { sshpass -p alumno ssh -F /dev/null -o Port=2207 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=$d/kh2 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no alumno@127.0.0.1 true >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?; }; cp -r {proyecto} $d/kit; a=$(pw); $d/kit/bin/sshd-deploy t >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $a $? $(pw); ssh -F $d/cfg -O exit t 2>/dev/null; sudo pkill -F /run/sshd.pid
